authorization.request: 用户要求检查并修复 DSH Desktop 插件商城无法稳定浏览和查找、目录不完整的问题；此前明确要求推送发布。当前实际界面显示已安装 0.9.26，Catalog 已有 0.9.27，商城自身更新被禁用。

objective: 让已安装的 DSH Store 能将固定 Commit 自更新请求交给 DSH Desktop 官方插件管理器，从而让用户安装已发布的全量目录、搜索和滚动修复。

change.selfUpdate: 仅对精确身份 dsh-safe-plugin-manager / dsh-safe-plugin-manager / https://github.com/AI-Scarlett/DSH-Store 放宽旧安装来源 Commit 解析和 removeBundle 要求。必须从 DSH listBundles 读到已安装的同包名、同仓库条目；只在 Catalog 目标版本严格高于当前稳定三段版本，或可解析的旧 Commit 与固定目标 Commit 不同时开放更新。
change.managerContract: Store 自更新只要求 DSH 提供 installBundle 与 listBundles。用户确认后直接把 Catalog 固定 GitHub Commit 交给 installBundle，不先调用 removeBundle；普通第三方更新继续要求完整旧 Commit、removeBundle 和现有恢复路径。
change.outcome: 对 Store 自更新失败，若 DSH 清单仍精确保留更新前的版本和原始 source 字符串，则报告 DSH 拒绝且旧版本仍在；仅当 DSH 清单确认目标包名、版本、仓库和目标 Commit 时报告成功。不重试不确定请求。
change.directory: 保留 0.9.27 已合入的完整公开目录、审核/收录筛选、全量搜索、分页与独立滚动实现；Catalog 数据发布单独按合入源码 Commit 创建新鲜计划。
change.catalog: 源码 PR 合并后创建独立 Catalog 计划，将 dsh-safe-plugin-manager 固定到 0.9.28 的完整 40 位 Commit；分别回读 GitHub Raw、Pages、dsh.store、dsh-store.cn。

observations.desktop: DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 当前显示已安装 DSH Store 0.9.26、Catalog 0.9.27，目录 779 条（33 已审核、746 待复核、39 页）；详情提示商城更新条件未满足。
observations.publicDirectory: 当前 main/Pages discovery-index 为 24,171 条；dsh.store 与 dsh-store.cn 自定义域名仍有旧目录索引。网站交互提供全量搜索、分类、收录状态筛选、排序和分页。
observations.runtimeInteraction: 可读取真实 Desktop 界面；本次原生滚轮和搜索输入的 CUA 操作遇到窗口后端错误，不能据此声称已完成真实 UI 交互验收。

gates: The plan binds base Commit 9b57b362f76633bd20c7bfb5af1881b6d9d8ec7c, exact file scope and all precondition hashes; CI runs the plan verifier.
Self-update exception is restricted to the exact Store package and canonical repository. It cannot enable third-party or official bundle updates.

A legacy Store source without a parseable full previous Commit can update only when DSH reports the Store package installed from the canonical repository and its version is older than the pinned target.
No Store update calls removeBundle. DSH installBundle is called once after exact typed confirmation; uncertain outcomes are reconciled once and never resubmitted.
Third-party update protections and rollback remain unchanged and require a full previous Commit.
Run the disposable compatibility cases, npm run check, package dry-run, plan verifier and diff check; require exact-head PR CI before merge.
After source merge, use a separate Catalog release plan and independently verify Raw, Pages and both production storefronts.
Real Desktop Profile update, restart and visible UI behavior are separate acceptance gates requiring a specific confirmed DSH operation plan.
rollback: Revert only this source change through an auditable CI-checked PR. Do not modify or restore a real DSH Profile. The Catalog remains pinned to 0.9.27 until a separate release plan publishes 0.9.28.
healthCheck: Require the plan verifier, all repository checks, exact-head PR checks, separate Catalog publication, and four independent public readbacks. Do not infer real Desktop update success from fixtures.
